run.change_description: fix(utils/body,validator): normalize Content-Type media type for case-insensitive matching

summary.intent: Fix honojs/hono#5060: normalize the Content-Type media type before matching in parseBody() and validator() so mixed/upper-case media types (e.g. `Application/JSON`, `Application/X-WWW-Form-Urlencoded`) are parsed instead of silently yielding `{}` or skipping validation, while leaving parameters such as multipart boundaries untouched.
summary.issue_fit: Met — every acceptance point and suggested test from honojs/hono#5060 (parseBody urlencoded, validator json, validator form including multipart boundary preservation) is implemented and covered by a passing new test.

observations.fact: `parseFormData` now stores the in-flight `formData()` promise directly into `HonoRequest.bodyCache.formData` (declared as `FormData`) before awaiting it; this matches the pre-existing runtime idiom in `HonoRequest#cachedBody`, which always stores an unawaited promise there, so it works correctly despite the misleading static type.

Codecov reports patch coverage of 76.47% with 3 uncovered lines in body.ts and 1 in buffer.ts; the reviewer's local run confirms every new test in this diff passes, so the uncovered lines are pre-existing branches, not the new mixed-case-matching behavior.

requirements.evidence: src/utils/body.ts:104-106 computes `mediaType = contentType?.split(';')[0].trim().toLowerCase()` and compares it against `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`; src/utils/body.test.ts adds `should parse mixed-case \`x-www-form-urlencoded\`` which passed under the reviewer's vitest run.

src/validator/validator.ts:24 adds the `/i` flag to `jsonRegex`; src/validator/validator.test.ts adds `Should validate if Content-Type media type is mixed-case` (`Application/JSON`), which passed under the reviewer's vitest run.

src/validator/validator.ts:25-26 adds `/i` to `multipartRegex`/`urlencodedRegex`; src/validator/validator.test.ts adds mixed-case urlencoded and multipart tests, and src/utils/buffer.test.ts adds a mixed-case-media-type-with-boundary test; all passed under the reviewer's vitest run.

src/utils/buffer.ts:113 lowercases only the substring before the first `;` via `contentType.replace(/^[^;]+/, (mediaType) => mediaType.toLowerCase())`, leaving parameter values such as the multipart `boundary` untouched; the new buffer.test.ts case asserts a mixed-case boundary (`sampleBoundary`) is still found by name after normalization.
body.test.ts (+28/-9), buffer.test.ts (+14), validator.test.ts (+48) add mixed-case-media-type coverage for every changed path.
